aboutH2: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall: Residential Rehab on Twelve Mile Creek
intro: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall is a private residential addiction program in a restored 19th-century stone estate in St. Catharines, in Ontario's Niagara Region. The house stands on wooded grounds above Twelve Mile Creek, and people live there for six, nine or twelve weeks of treatment for alcohol, drug and gambling problems.

Until mid-2026 the estate ran as Freeport Recovery. It now carries the Twelve Mile name and runs the same program as the smaller Twelve Mile house on Lake Street, with one-to-one therapy, small groups, physician oversight and a strong focus on physical training, from martial arts to yoga and breathwork.

pillars.title: An Old Merritt Family Estate Above Twelve Mile Creek
pillars.body: Rodman Hall was built for Thomas Rodman Merritt between about 1857 and 1863 and spent most of the last century as a public art gallery. The stone house now holds drawing rooms with marble fireplaces, a piano room, a lounge with a putting green and a dining hall under a stained-glass ceiling. Outside there is a covered veranda, raised garden beds, stone courtyards and paths that drop through the woods toward Twelve Mile Creek. Downtown St. Catharines is a few minutes away, but from the garden you mostly see trees.

pillars.title: Therapy in the Morning, Training in the Afternoon
pillars.body: A day at Rodman Hall starts with movement, meditation and breakfast. Daytime is for one-to-one sessions with a master's-level therapist and small group therapy, using approaches such as CBT and mindfulness-based stress reduction. In the afternoon residents use the estate's studio and gym for Brazilian jiu-jitsu, Muay Thai, boxing, strength work and yoga, and there is a cedar sauna and a red-light room off the gym. Evenings end with a shared meal and peer support in the dining hall.

pillars.title: Six Weeks of Reintegration, Then Aftercare for Life
pillars.body: When the residential stay ends, you keep working with the same counsellor through six weeks of virtual reintegration, and that is part of the program fee. After that you join the alumni community for life, with group and one-to-one sessions through Twelve Mile's private app. Families have their own space in the app. The Lake Street house is also due to become a reintegration home for people moving from residence back to independent living.

overviewH2: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall: Centre Overview
overview: Rodman Hall is the larger of Twelve Mile Recovery's two houses in St. Catharines. It treats adults with alcohol and drug addiction, gambling and the anxiety, depression and trauma that often come with them, in a residential program led by Twelve Mile's clinical team. It is a private centre, and it does not provide detox on site.

location.heading: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall in St. Catharines, Ontario
location.intro: Rodman Hall stands on St Paul Crescent in St. Catharines, on the wooded bank of Twelve Mile Creek a short drive west of downtown and of Twelve Mile's Lake Street house. Toronto is about an hour and a quarter away by the QEW, Hamilton about 45 minutes, and Niagara Falls, Welland and Grimsby are each around 20 to 25 minutes by car.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's own website and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall cost?
faqs.a: recovery.com lists an estimate of $27,000 CAD for the full program at Rodman Hall, which covers six weeks of residential treatment and six weeks of virtual care. Twelve Mile's own FAQ gives a range of $20,000 to $30,000 for a six-week stay, depending on program, length of stay and room. Admissions confirms the exact fee on the first call.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Rodman Hall?
faqs.a: Residential stays at Rodman Hall are six, nine or twelve weeks, depending on what you need. They are followed by a six-week virtual reintegration program with the same counsellor, which is included, and then lifetime alumni aftercare.

No. Twelve Mile Recovery is not a detox facility and asks for at least 72 hours of sobriety before arrival. If you need medical withdrawal management first, the team can refer you to a withdrawal service before you start.

faqs.q: Where is Rodman Hall and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Rodman Hall is at 109 St Paul Crescent in St. Catharines, in Ontario's Niagara Region, on the wooded bank of Twelve Mile Creek. It is about an hour and a quarter from Toronto by the QEW, about 45 minutes from Hamilton and around 20 minutes from Niagara Falls. Call admissions before you travel so they can plan your arrival.

faqs.q: How is Rodman Hall different from Twelve Mile Recovery on Lake Street?
faqs.a: Both houses belong to the same program. Rodman Hall is the large heritage estate on Twelve Mile Creek, with gardens, woodland trails, a gym, a studio, a sauna and a red-light room. Twelve Mile Recovery on Lake Street is a smaller renovated house in downtown St. Catharines that the centre calls its most affordable six-week option. We list them separately as Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall and Twelve Mile Recovery.

faqs.q: Is Rodman Hall the same place as Freeport Recovery?
faqs.a: Yes. The estate operated as Freeport Recovery until June 2026, when Freeport Recovery Group signed an operating agreement with Twelve Mile Recovery and the site was renamed Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall. The old freeportrecovery.ca address now forwards to twelvemilerecovery.ca.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave Rodman Hall?
faqs.a: You move into six weeks of virtual reintegration with the counsellor you had in residence, at no extra cost. After that you become an alumni member for life, with group and one-to-one sessions through the centre's private app, which also has a space for families.

faqs.q: Is Rodman Hall private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private, fee-based centre, so OHIP does not usually cover it. Twelve Mile does not bill insurers directly, but it provides detailed receipts you can submit to an extended health or employer plan. Financing is available through Medicard by iFinance.

The program treats alcohol and drug addiction, including opioids and fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs and cannabis, as well as gambling. Mental health concerns that come with addiction, such as anxiety, depression and trauma, are treated alongside it.

faqs.q: What are the bedrooms like at Rodman Hall?
faqs.a: Rodman Hall has single rooms and shared rooms for two. Many of them have a marble fireplace, bay windows or an ensuite bathroom, and the centre's tour shows them furnished with desks and armchairs.

faqs.q: Can my family visit during treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, when it is clinically appropriate. Twelve Mile supports family visits that fit the treatment plan and runs family therapy and education, and families keep their own space in the alumni app after discharge.
